mapper.select: select * from store_member_recharge where recharge_no = #{rechargeNo} and deleted = 0 limit 1
mapper.update: update store_member_recharge set pay_status = 1, transaction_id = #{transactionId}, paid_time = #{paidTime}, update_time = #{paidTime} where recharge_no = #{rechargeNo} and deleted = 0 and pay_status in (0, 2)
update store_member_recharge set prepay_id = #{prepayId}, update_time = now() where recharge_no = #{rechargeNo} and deleted = 0

update store_member_recharge set settle_status = 1, settle_time = #{settleTime}, settle_by = #{settleBy}, update_time = #{settleTime} where deleted = 0 and store_id = #{storeId} and ifnull(settle_status, 0) = 0 and pay_status = 1

update store_member_recharge set wx_shipping_status = #{status}, wx_shipping_errcode = #{errcode}, wx_shipping_errmsg = #{errmsg}, wx_shipping_retry = #{retry}, wx_shipping_time = #{shippingTime}, update_time = now() where recharge_no = #{rechargeNo} and deleted = 0
mapper.select: select * from store_member_recharge where deleted = 0 and pay_status = 1 and (wx_shipping_status is null or wx_shipping_status in (0, 2)) and ifnull(wx_shipping_retry, 0) < #{maxRetry} order by paid_time asc, id asc limit #{limit}
